specs.title: Booking agent reschedule and cancel
specs.why: Most real conversations are changes to existing bookings, not new ones.
specs.scope: Extend the agent with find, reschedule and cancel tools honouring the tenant cancellation policy.
acceptance: Cancelling inside the policy window issues a refund, verified by `pnpm test`
Cancelling outside the window retains the deposit per `lib/policy.ts`
Rescheduling updates the booking and notifies the owner

specs.title: Agent guardrails
specs.why: An agent with booking and payment tools on a public channel is an attack surface.
specs.scope: Defences against prompt injection, cross-tenant calls, abuse and runaway usage, with human handoff.
tasks: Add `lib/agent/runtime.ts`: assert tenant scope before every tool call
acceptance: Every case in `tests/agent-redteam.test.ts` is blocked, verified by `pnpm test`
The handoff command halts the agent and alerts the owner
